about: What MA-240 meant to change at the boards' drawn sizes, for `node scripts/board_fit.js --diff d6e243f --since 8e4b675 --expect review/MA-240/drawn-changes.json` (d6e243f is main before MA-240, 8e4b675 its merge). Every other frame of every board MA-240 left is unchanged pixel for pixel; a board a later story redrew (its own file, or a file it alone loads, changed after 8e4b675) is left out by name, and that story's own diff answers for it (MA-282). The neutral CSS puts one grey on the track, the range band and the accent on both sides, so their new colours (checked by scripts/contrast_check.py, and the track and band checked as applied on every board by the gate) do not hide a change in layout.
neutral: *, ::before, ::after { --mp-track: #8a8a8a !important; --mp-band: rgba(138, 138, 138, 0.4) !important; --mp-accent: #8a8a8a !important; } .mp :is(.mp-track, .meter:not(:has(> .mp-track)), .ftrack, .mwk:not(.on), .sr-t, .pl-t, .rl-t) { background: #8a8a8a !important; box-shadow: none !important; } .mp .fband { fill: rgba(138, 138, 138, 0.4) !important; }
